definitions.explanation: Organic kitchen and garden waste broken down into fertilizer, or the container or system used to make it. A loanword from English "compost".

examples.japanese: {生|なま}ごみ⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧コンポスト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧。
examples.english: Put food scraps into the compost.

examples.japanese: ⟦{家庭|かてい}→家庭：12315_katei⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧コンポスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{始|はじ}めた→始める：00531_hajimeru⟧。
コンポスト⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{作|つく}った→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧⟦{肥料|ひりょう}→肥料：06102_hiryou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{畑|はたけ}→畑：00842_hatake⟧にまいた。
examples.english: I spread the fertilizer made from compost on the field.

notes:
Loanword from English "compost". Refers both to the composted material and to the bin or system used to make it.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- コンポスト⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{作|つく}る→作る：00481_tsukuru⟧: to make compost
- {生|なま}ごみコンポスト: food-waste composting
- コンポスト⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{入|い}れる→入れる：01098_ireru⟧: to put into the compost
